name: Juicebox
description: Connect Juicebox to Claude to explore your sourcing insights and put Agents to work finding candidates. Ask about usage, projects, and outreach, or launch a Juicebox agent straight from a job description.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Juicebox to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Juicebox to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.juicebox.ai/v1. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Juicebox MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Juicebox provides these MCP tools: create_agent, get_agent_schema, get_candidate_details, get_data, get_project, get_schema, manage_agent, ping, resolve, search_shortlist, start_sourcing, and whoami.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Juicebox?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Juicebox in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Juicebox requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Juicebox is developed by Juicebox. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
